checks: A new game opens with a dated intro, then enters the original move-in prologue without spending a day
An intro save resumes its current page; skipping bypasses only the intro and preserves the first story choice
The short intro advances automatically, pauses in menus and background, and respects reduced motion
Actual runtime keeps draft cancellation separate from sending, then reads and hears the letter exactly once
Saving and reloading the actual first-work scene preserves charged energy and pays pending wages once at completion
An actual heroine conversation returns to the same time and consumes its daily opportunity once
Ending daytime visits the mandatory festival first, and the unchosen heroine receives no invented reward
Canceling a paid activity keeps resources unchanged; manual slots restore a prior time and resources
June content checkpoint never masquerades as a completed full-game ending
The three-person work event commits one shift, one salary, and only the authored shared rewards
The location panel conceals people and previewing changes only the scenery until the player visits
Buying and giving a gift use separate confirmations, with no time charge and no duplicated item after reload
An actual paid date resumes mid-choice, advances exactly two slots, and adds its selected memory once
A mandatory evening prevents a date and a shared conversation uses both daily talks without jealousy
runtime: Node VM + DOM adapter; real production game handlers; no browser layout or native file picker
